subject: Quick question about transport
text: Hi, I'm trying to get something sorted before Friday and I'm not really keeping track anymore. The cleanup team just told me my assigned site moved because the alley was blocked, so now I'm wondering whether the volunteer transport service still covers the new corner or if it only works for the original list. I also mixed up the pickup window, and I think I wrote 2:30 instead of 3:30 in the sign-up notes. If that matters, please tell me. Another thing: are the rain ponchos returned to the same place, or do we leave them at the shelter? The last-minute change has my whole morning upside down, and I can't find the flyer with the phone number. Sorry this is all in one go. Thanks
